result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears largely functional, with a few minor layout and content issues related to truncated text and duplicate listings.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are truncated ('Smash Bros Bu...') due to the card extending beyond the visible screen area.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card text is fully visible or add proper truncation with ellipsis that fits within card boundaries; consider adjusting carousel spacing.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' listings appear side by side with the same details (15-25 min, €0.90 delivery), which may confuse users.
issues.suggestion: Verify if these are genuinely distinct locations; if duplicates, remove one or differentiate them with location/branch info.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons have inconsistent styling — one appears with a dark filled background circle while another is white/outlined.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon appearance across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
